items.text: Yahya Rahim Safavi, assistant and senior advisor to Mojtaba Khamenei, said enemies thought they could bring Iran down in a few days, but the people and armed forces stood firm. He added that Americans know Iran is at full power and readiness. Safavi also described Mojtaba Khamenei as a brave imam, whom he saw three times on the front lines, calling him very brave and powerful.

The head of the Health and Treatment Commission of the Islamic Consultative Assembly reported a sharp increase in drug and treatment costs, drug shortages, and people's inability to pay medical expenses. He stated that treatment costs have become "crippling" for people and the health situation has worsened compared to the past. He also reported severe poverty, unemployment, and deprivation of some cities in Sistan and Baluchestan from safe drinking water and basic health facilities.
A released video shows the disposal of tens of tons of apples in Semirom due to their non-export despite sanctions and blockades.

Thibaut Courtois, the Belgian goalkeeper of Real Madrid, missed the crucial Sunday match against Barcelona in El Clasico due to influenza. Real Madrid club announced that Courtois was excluded from the team's player list due to illness. Andriy Lunin is expected to be Real Madrid's main goalkeeper in this match.

Iranian media reported that the Iranian national judo team lost the opportunity to participate in the Abu Dhabi Grand Slam due to the UAE not issuing visas for the team members. The team had previously registered for the competition and was scheduled to compete on the 7th and 8th of Aban, but despite coordination, visas were not issued and the team's dispatch was canceled. The Abu Dhabi Grand Slam is an important judo competition that can affect athletes' Olympic ranking points, and previously Kuwait also did not issue visas for the Iranian national paddle team members.

The Judiciary Media Center announced the indictment of Saeed Shakiba, a voice actor, blogger, and satirist, on charges of "deliberate support of Israel in cyberspace, insult, and propagandistic activity against the Islamic Republic system through blackening and support for Pahlavi." Shakiba had previously been arrested following the release of a video imitating Ali Khamenei's voice. The judiciary had announced on Wednesday, 22 Mehr, the opening of a case against this artist in Tehran's prosecutor's office.
A ranger in the protected area of Kalebid in Malayer was injured during a mission due to shooting by illegal hunters with a pellet gun.

Volodymyr Zelensky, President of Ukraine, says Russia attacked Ukraine in one week with about 2,300 drones, 1,600 guided bombs, and 48 missiles. According to him, these attacks caused civilian casualties and extensive damage to energy infrastructure in 9 regions.

Reza Amiri-Moghaddam, the ambassador of the Islamic Republic in Pakistan, announced that there are no restrictions on the export of Iranian goods to Pakistan, including liquefied gas, and that Iran's borders with neighboring countries are open. He attributed disruptions in the shipment of Iranian cargo to changes in Pakistan's import form issuance process and said negotiations to resolve this issue are ongoing. Amiri-Moghaddam emphasized that border trade is important for the interests of both countries and that Iran is working with Pakistan to resolve existing problems.

The Tehran Provincial Court of Appeal confirmed the 9-month prison sentence of Babak Eslami Farsani, a lawyer, for the charge of "propaganda against the regime through cyberspace." This sentence was previously issued by Branch 23 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court. The appellate court's ruling was issued on 26 Mehr.

Tractor club announced that the team will travel with a direct Meraj Airlines flight from Tabriz to Dubai for the match against Al Ain UAE in the Asian Elite League. Meraj Airlines is an Iranian company that has VIP planes for transporting Islamic Republic officials and can use flight exemptions. Tractor managers said that flying with Meraj Airlines costs 30 billion tomans and there is no difference compared to flying with the government plane.

Mohammad Ali Sabetghadam, head of the Sports Facilities Development and Maintenance Company, announced that the initial operation of Azadi Stadium will take place in late Azar or early Dey this year. He said the renovation project started in early Mordad 1403 and 23% of the western side operations have progressed so far. The costs incurred are about 3500 billion tomans, and it is predicted that the renovation will be completed with 4 to 5 thousand billion tomans.

Images released show that preparation, seed mixing, and grass planting operations at Azadi Stadium started on Sunday. Hybrid grass will be used, and grass planting will be completed alongside seat installation. Mohammad Ali Sabetghadam announced that Azadi Stadium will be ready for initial operation by late Azar or early Dey.
The Welfare Organization of Fars Province announced that 360 working and street children received support services from the organization's day and night centers during the first half of this year.

The doors of Reza Shah's palace in Kelardasht have opened to the public after years. This palace, known as the Ojabet Palace, was built in 1318 with a combined Iranian-European architecture. During its construction, artifacts about three thousand years old were uncovered, including the Kelardasht Golden Cup.

In Gachsaran county, Kohgiluyeh and Boyer-Ahmad province, 79 rural schools with a population of 2,665 students face shortages of educational equipment, infrastructure deterioration, and safety issues on commuting routes. The governor of Gachsaran announced that the allocated 50 billion rials for school renovation and improvement is insufficient to meet existing needs. The county's education director also emphasized the necessity of securing student commuting routes, including the area around Shahid Hejazi School on the Abgarmu route.

Reuters reported that Qatari mediators have traveled to Tehran with coordination from the US to reduce regional tensions. The Hill reported, citing informed sources, that the US military has prepared several options for renewed attacks on Iranian targets after the November 3 midterm elections. The implementation of these plans depends on approval by Donald Trump, and no final decision has been announced yet.

An indictment was issued against an Instagram blogger in Tehran for publishing content on social media. The charges include propaganda activities against the regime and endorsing Israel on social media. His case has been sent to court for trial.

Forough Kenani, a sociology researcher, said that Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf's reference to the Pahlavi family is a sign of the Islamic Republic's concern about the formation of a political alternative. She added that the government's attention to this movement should be considered a sign of their concern about the position and influence of the Pahlavi family.

Sri Lankan officials announced that at least 40 Iranian sailors from US-sanctioned oil tankers stranded near Sri Lankan waters need urgent medical care and have been transferred to shore for treatment. These sailors were transferred to shore on the 2nd and 3rd of Aban via the port of Galle. The Sri Lankan Foreign Ministry confirmed coordination for the transfer and said the costs were borne by the Iranian embassy.

The mother of Abolfazl Ataei, a teenager killed in the Mahsa uprising, said the Islamic Republic is threatening families seeking justice to remain silent. She added that those seeking justice will not back down under any threats and their voices will not be silenced.

Mohsen Rastani, a well-known Iranian documentary and social photographer, died on Sunday, 3 Aban, at the age of 68. He had been living in Germany in recent years and returned to Iran in Mordad this year for continued treatment. Rastani began his professional career at the start of the Iran-Iraq war and also photographed the wars in Bosnia and Armenia.

This year's Nobel Prize in Economics was awarded to Robert Hall and Michael Woodford. Their research shows that the outcome of economic policies depends on the expectations of households and firms about the future and the credibility of central bank promises. Mohammad Mashinchian explains the achievements of these two economists in simple terms on the program "Chortakeh".

A defendant in Zahedan was sentenced by Branch 105 of the Criminal Court Two to 70 lashes and one year imprisonment. The sentence is related to a case of insulting emergency staff during duty and damaging a government ambulance.

The German army is participating with 10 staff officers and two refueling aircraft in the first exercise of the coalition of 35 countries supporting Ukraine, led by France and the UK. This exercise will take place next month in Poland, Romanian airspace, and the western Black Sea. The goal of the exercise is to assess the readiness of multinational forces to ensure a possible ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine.

Donald Trump said in a phone interview with Fox News that he must decide whether to finish the job or make a deal, emphasizing that the decision time is approaching soon. He added that the three facilities bombed by the US have not been rebuilt and are covered by thousands of tons of stones. Trump compared these attacks to those of previous US presidents, saying this is a real attack and not a game.

The World Greco-Roman Wrestling Championships in Astana, Kazakhstan, saw three Iranian representatives lose in crucial matches. Ali Ahmadi-Vafa and Payam Ahmadi were defeated in the finals, and Mohammad Hadi Saravi failed to advance to the final match. Meanwhile, Gholamreza Farkhi won the gold medal.

Milad Goodarzi, a pro-government media activist, spoke about ambiguity in the Islamic Republic's oil sales process and the creation of rent for oil buyers. He warned about the unclear fate of about 11 billion dollars of unpaid oil receivables. Goodarzi also said part of this money was spent on luxury cars in Dubai.
Videos received by Iran International show that a group of Iranians residing in Germany gathered against the Islamic Republic on Saturday, 2 Aban, in the cities of Nuremberg, Hamburg, and Stuttgart.

Persepolis football team, the leader of the Premier League, lost 1-0 to Foolad Khuzestan in the tenth week. The only goal was scored by Vahid Amiri in the 87th minute for Foolad. Despite this loss, Persepolis remained top of the league due to a better goal difference.

Masoud Pezeshkian, head of the Islamic Republic government, announced at the Supreme Council for Health and Food Security meeting that the December protests were mostly due to social harms. He added that if people trust the government and know it wants to help them and solve their problems, they will definitely cooperate. Pezeshkian emphasized that social harms and risks threaten public health and will bring many problems.

Benjamin Netanyahu, the Prime Minister of Israel, announced that there are intelligence indications suggesting that Iran and its proxy forces might challenge Israel with attacks to disrupt the elections. He warned that Israel will deliver much heavier blows than the enemies expect, and these blows will be decisive and crushing.

The public and revolutionary prosecutor of South Khorasan province reported the closure of the 'White Palace' recreational and hospitality complex in Birjand due to what was described as 'non-compliance with Islamic norms.'
A video shows that a citizen has cooked sholeh zard in memory of the immortal figures of the Iranian National Revolution and is distributing packages bearing their names among the people.
Trump said that no attack will take place today.

Shayan Samiei, a national security expert, said the trip of the Qatari mediation delegation to Tehran coordinated with the US may reduce the risk of immediate conflict but does not mean the crisis is resolved. He added that the Islamic Republic, while maintaining hardline positions and welcoming mediation, seeks to buy time and reduce external pressures.

According to HRANA news agency, Sarina Zaeri, Barbad Sepehri, and Arshia Jaberi, three Baha'i citizens residing in Shiraz, are being held in an undetermined status in Adelabad Prison in Shiraz, despite 42 days passing since their arrest. These citizens were transferred to Adelabad Prison in Shiraz on Thursday, October 22. Their families' efforts to clarify their case and secure their temporary release on bail have so far been unsuccessful.

A video released on social media shows Alireza Dabir, the head of the Wrestling Federation, physically clashing with referees and the mat chairman after Hadi Saravi's unexpected loss to Artur Sergesyan, a Russian wrestler, in the semifinals of the World Greco-Roman Wrestling Championships in Astana, Kazakhstan. His protest was against warnings given to Hadi Saravi by the referees, which ultimately led to his defeat. The national Greco-Roman wrestling team, in the first four weight categories of the 2026 World Championships in Astana, Kazakhstan, won only one gold medal, while two other finalists took silver.

Mehdi Tartaar, Persepolis coach, said after the home defeat against Foolad Khuzestan that Foolad had no chances but his team was surprised in a counterattack. He added that his players tried and took responsibility for the loss, emphasizing the need to learn from mistakes and not to grieve the defeat for more than 24 hours. Tartaar also asked fans to be patient and said that losing is part of football.

Benjamin Netanyahu, Prime Minister of Israel, warned on Sunday, 3 Aban 1405, that Iran or its allied forces might carry out attacks against Israel in the coming days. Netanyahu said intelligence signs indicate that Iran and its affiliated forces might try to disrupt the election process through attacks. This warning was issued two days before the Israeli elections.

Yadollah Javani, the political deputy of the IRGC, said that Americans can no longer return to the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz, the Sea of Oman, and their bases. He added that the circle of avengers is not limited to one group but includes freedom seekers worldwide and resistance forces, each of whom will strive for vengeance in their own way.

A member of Tehran City Council said that workers at recycling booths in districts 5, 21, and 22 of Tehran have three months of unpaid wages and benefits. Additionally, some service workers of the Waste Management Organization have been dismissed for one month. About 15 seasonal workers at the Aq Dareh gold mine have not had their contracts renewed, and workers at Azadi Stadium have protested again over unpaid wages for three months.

Meir Javdanfar, an analyst on Israeli affairs, said Netanyahu is trying to strengthen his electoral position by highlighting the threat of the Islamic Republic and Trump's support. He emphasized that despite Netanyahu lagging in the polls, the possibility of his victory cannot yet be ruled out.

Four weeks of protests and looting in France have been reported without protesters being killed. This has been compared to the bloody crackdown in Iran. An interview was conducted with Iman Aghayari, a political analyst.
In the audio version of Titrawal with Niousha Saremi, new CENTCOM plans for another attack on Iran after the US elections were discussed.

US media report that the US and Israel have drafted new plans for a fresh wave of attacks on Iran. According to the latest report by The Hill, CENTCOM has prepared options for a possible attack on Iran after the US midterm elections. These options have been presented to Pete Hegseth to be implemented if approved by Donald Trump.

Jamshid Barzegar, journalist and political analyst, said that claims about meetings between Islamic Republic officials and Mojtaba Khamenei do not clarify the ambiguity about his status. He said the continued absence of the Supreme Leader is also raising questions among the regime's supporters and presents an image of instability in the power structure.

At the end of the tenth week of the Iranian Football Premier League, Persepolis remained at the top of the table due to a better goal difference than Sepahan, Tractor, and Esteghlal. These four teams have 20 points. Tractor has a canceled match with Malavan, and if its result is announced in favor of Tractor, it will become the leader.

Several citizens in Hormozgan province were arrested by the Intelligence Organization forces of the IRGC for sending videos to Persian-language media outside the country. In the released video of forced confessions of these citizens, four people including three women are seen.
A video received by Iran International on Sunday, 3 Aban, shows protesters writing the slogan "Long live the Shah" on a bus seat in Shiraz.

Today, Sunday, October 25, 2026, a number of retirees from the country's steel industries gathered in front of the Ministry of Cooperatives, Labor, and Social Welfare in Tehran, and a group of Isfahan steel retirees gathered in front of the governorate building in that city. Also, Social Security retirees in Shush, Rasht, Ahvaz, and Tehran held rallies, demanding the implementation of relevant laws, an increase in pensions, and an improvement in their medical conditions. In another event, a group of nomads from Izeh county gathered in recent days at the county's Nomadic Affairs Department building to protest the elimination of their flour quota.

Two days after Netanyahu's order to Mossad to overthrow the Islamic Republic, the former head of Mossad revealed that Israeli spies have not been arrested in Iran and are still active in Tehran. Barnia also spoke about the details of deceiving the Islamic Republic's intelligence organizations to protect Mossad spies.

Asieh Amini, a social issues analyst, said Masoud Pezeshkian reduces the political demands of the December protesters to "social harms," while the people demand the overthrow of the Islamic Republic. She emphasized that the government, instead of responding to the killing of protesters, attributes the problems to the people and foreign agents.
Iran International has released an audio version of Trump's plan to "finish off the Islamic Republic."

Parsa Najafi, a 19-year-old Baháʼí citizen, has been held in custody without clear status in Isfahan's Dastgerd prison for over 140 days and is deprived of meeting or contacting his family. Harana reported that he has been in this uncertain situation for 42 days and his family remains unaware of his condition. Judicial authorities have not provided clear answers to his family, increasing their concerns.

Hossein Ghazian, a sociologist, pointed to the high anxiety rates among one-fifth of Tehran's citizens and said this situation goes beyond an individual problem and stems from social insecurity and unpredictability of the future. He emphasized that psychological treatments alone are not sufficient as long as the sense of security and control over life does not return.

The Ministry of Sports announced that the Fitex Tehran exhibition was held without connection to the ministry or the Tehran Sports Department and without their permission, and the matter is under investigation. The exhibition was held from October 21 to October 23, 2026, in Goftogoo Park. Videos from the exhibition showing women exercising faced widespread criticism from state media, and the Islamic Republic Broadcasting called for action against the organizers.

The mother of Mani Shafiei said her son was killed in front of the mosque where his father prayed every day. Mani Shafiei, 18 years old, was killed on 19 Dey 1404 in Islamshahr. His father was also shot the same night.

Prince Reza Pahlavi reacted to the end of exile and the return of Maria Corina Machado, the Venezuelan opposition leader, calling this event a source of hope for the people of Venezuela and an inspiration for freedom and democracy fighters worldwide. In a message to Machado, he congratulated her on returning to her homeland and emphasized that the people of Iran stand alongside the people of Venezuela. He believes that with the freedom of Iran and Venezuela, a new chapter of friendship and lasting cooperation between the nations will begin.

Mahmoud Shakiba, head of the Golestan Environmental Wildlife Department, unveiled a fossilized piece of tree trunk about 170 million years old on the occasion of National Fossil Day, November 3. He said this fossil was discovered in 1400 in one of the excavated parts of the Azadshahr–Shahroud road and was relocated to prevent damage.
A video received by Iran International shows that a group of Iranians residing in the UK gathered on Sunday, 3 Aban, in Birmingham to protest against the executions by the Islamic Republic.

Abbas Aragchi, the Islamic Republic's foreign minister, said that almost all US bases in the region have been damaged and more than 80 American planes and fighter jets, mostly on the ground, were targeted by Islamic Republic missiles. He added that Tehran's policy remains to ensure regional security without the presence of foreign forces.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, said the Jomhouri Eslami newspaper in Tehran claimed that Israel is seeking to bring Mahmoud Ahmadinejad back to power and that the removal of Islamic Republic officials and attacks on current and former government figures are part of this plan. Vaisi added that Ahmadinejad's return to power seems more like an illusion than reality because the majority of the Iranian people want the overthrow of the entire Islamic Republic and have shown the most support for Prince Reza Pahlavi.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, said Ahmadinejad, with his ambitious and power-seeking spirit, wants to sideline everyone in Iran and become the sole holder of power. He believes that people do not want the clerics, but Ahmadinejad is popular among the people. He also said that the historical memory of the Iranian people says otherwise, and Ahmadinejad cannot change his true face among the people with Botox.

Real Madrid defeated Barcelona 2-1 at the Camp Nou in the tenth week of La Liga, ending Hansi Flick's team's 100% winning streak this season. Mbappe scored at minutes 41 and 87 for Real Madrid, and Raphinha scored at minute 61 for Barcelona. Barcelona leads the table with 27 points, and Real Madrid is third with 24 points.

Kamyar Behrang, a member of Iran International's editorial team, said Benjamin Netanyahu's warning about the possibility of military action by the Islamic Republic and its proxy forces ahead of the Israeli elections should be taken seriously. He added that the main Israeli parties agree in assessing the Islamic Republic as a security threat, and Tehran uses misleading information to influence Israel's political atmosphere. Also, neither of the two main political blocs in Israel has the necessary majority to form a government, and coalition negotiations after the elections will be decisive.

Houshang Hasan-Yari, a military expert, said Saudi Arabia has conventional military superiority over the Houthis but has not yet been able to stop the Houthis' missile and drone attacks. He considered Saudi Arabia's defense pact with Pakistan and Turkey to lack serious military impact and added that Western defensive support is mostly limited to intercepting attacks. He believes that without effective military action against the Houthis, the threat from this group against Saudi Arabia, the Red Sea, and the energy market will continue.

Morad Vaisi, senior analyst at Iran International, said: "From the perspective of the majority of the Iranian people, there is no difference between Ahmadinejad and other killers of the people. The majority of the Iranian people have moved beyond the entirety of the Islamic Republic, and their historic choice is Prince Reza Pahlavi."

The Kurdpa news agency reported that Rojan Ebrahimi, a 20-year-old mixed martial arts athlete from Saqqez, attempted suicide following repeated summons, threats, and pressure from the intelligence agency to cooperate in identifying and capturing political activists outside Iran. She survived after five days hospitalized. She was arrested on 11 Mehr 1405 and was temporarily released on bail.

Benjamin Netanyahu, Prime Minister of Israel, warned the Islamic Republic and its allies on Sunday, 3 Aban, about attempts to disrupt the Israeli elections. He said there is intelligence indicating that the Islamic Republic and its proxy forces might create disruptions in the election process through attacks.

Kylian Mbappé scored a double in tonight's El Clásico, reaching his 100th goal for Real Madrid and leading his team to a 2-1 victory over Barcelona at Camp Nou. This decisive double came one day before the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony, for which Mbappé is one of the contenders. Mbappé is the 24th player to reach 100 goals for Real Madrid and the fourth fastest to achieve this milestone.

Maria Corina Machado, leader of the Venezuelan opposition, returned to the country on Sunday, 3 Aban, after nearly a year of absence and met with her supporters in Lara state. Trump said he was not aware of her return.

Donald Trump said he ended eight wars and intends to resolve two more. He also said he prevented the nuclear threat from the Islamic Republic, which he said could have had very dangerous consequences. Trump added he expected to receive the Nobel Peace Prize last year and criticized the award being given to Barack Obama.

Donald Trump said the increase in fuel prices due to the war with the Islamic Republic was an acceptable price to prevent Tehran from obtaining nuclear weapons. He also said the US has achieved a great victory and now more oil passes through the Strait of Hormuz. Trump also claimed that the Islamic Republic has killed more than 75,000 protesters in the past 9 months, but provided no independent evidence for this claim.

The Associated Press reported that amid rising concerns about a new round of war between the US, Israel, and the Islamic Republic, some residents of Tehran have started buying and stockpiling food, medicine, and essential items, while some are preparing to leave Tehran for safer cities in the north. The price of rice has increased by more than 60% and beef by more than 150%, with reports of medicine shortages. Meanwhile, the US has strengthened its military presence in the region and the possibility of renewed attacks remains.

Two sources told Reuters that senior officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan, member countries of the "Makkah Pact," are expected to meet with Iranian officials in Tehran on Monday, 4 Aban, to discuss regional coordination. According to these sources, Prince Khalid bin Salman, Saudi Arabia's Defense Minister, and Asim Munir, Pakistan's Army Chief, will represent their countries. The report did not mention the name of the Turkish representative.

Navid Mohibi, a political analyst, says that if military pressure on the Islamic Republic intensifies, the Iranian people should determine the country's political future. He says the US should not appoint any individual or political faction for Iran's future and must recognize the people's right to freely choose their destiny. He also emphasized the need to expand the Iranian opposition's connections with international forces beyond the US.

Ali Al-Nuaimi, head of the Defense, Interior, and Foreign Affairs Committee of the UAE Federal National Council, accused the Islamic Republic of "exporting instability" in response to Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf's criticism of Lana Nusseibeh's candidacy for UN Secretary-General. Al-Nuaimi stated that Ghalibaf's rhetoric represents the same destructive mindset that has brought much suffering to the region. He added that Lana Nusseibeh represents diplomacy, competence, and courage in building bridges.

Fuel cut for about 12,000 unlicensed fishing boats in Hormozgan has endangered the livelihood of thousands of coastal families. The CEO of the Hormozgan Fishermen's Cooperative Union warned that continuing this situation could lead to increased unemployment and intensified social harms in coastal areas.

Roudaki Hall turned 59 on 4 Aban; a hall built with the support of Empress Farah Pahlavi for opera and ballet performances, which continued its activity under the name Vahdat Hall after the Islamic Revolution. This report covers the history and fate of this important cultural and artistic building in Iran.

Mary Apak, a veteran Iranian theater, television, and cinema actress and former member of the National Ballet of Iran, spoke to Iran International about her memories of performing at Rudaki Hall and the role of this venue in the flourishing of Iranian art. She recalled various ballet performances, the accompaniment of the Tehran Opera Orchestra, and the support of Empress Farah Pahlavi for Iranian art and culture.
Officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan will meet with officials of the Islamic Republic in Tehran on Monday, 4 Aban, to discuss regional coordination and Middle East security developments.

Iranians living in Calgary, Canada, continued their weekly gatherings by assembling in front of the city hall building to protest the death sentences of political prisoners. Sepidar Valian, a reporter for Iran International, reports.

Alireza Beiranvand, the goalkeeper of Tractor, went to Fars province to start his military service and will join the training sessions of Fajr Sepasi Shiraz after completing administrative procedures. He left Tehran at 5 AM on Monday, 4 Aban, and reported to his military unit at Abadeh barracks. Due to the closed transfer window, Beiranvand cannot participate in official matches for Fajr Sepasi yet and must wait until the mid-season transfer window to be registered on the team roster.

Hossein Alizadeh evaluates Donald Trump's repeated emphasis on preventing the Islamic Republic from acquiring nuclear weapons and the military achievements of the US within the framework of US electoral competitions. He says that lasting freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz has not yet been established and depends on the US military presence.

The Tehran prosecutor filed charges against the organizers of the Tehran Art Fair exhibition and a judicial case was opened. These individuals have been summoned to the prosecutor's office for what was described as "non-compliance with legal and religious regulations."
Reza Teyj, a citizen from Badreh, was released yesterday on bail.

Israel Katz, Israel's Defense Minister, denied reports of a dispute between Benjamin Netanyahu and Eyal Zamir over military action against Iran before the elections. Katz stated that Israel had no intention to attack Iran before the elections but would respond strongly if Iran attacked Israel. Reports had emerged that Netanyahu ordered military action that could lead to a confrontation with Iran ahead of the elections.

Luka Dončić scored 52 points to lead the Los Angeles Lakers to a 132-123 victory over the Utah Jazz in a tough game. Dončić played a decisive role in the fourth quarter with two consecutive three-pointers. This was the Lakers' third consecutive win in the new NBA season.
A citizen sent a video to Iran International on the evening of Sunday, 3 Aban, showing the nighttime harassment of government protesters against the people of Shiraz.

A video of forced confession by Ehsan Arbab, a blogger, was published on his Instagram page. He calls his activities "propaganda against the regime," "insulting the leadership," and supporting protests, and expresses regret for them. No information has been released about Ehsan Arbab's place of detention, official charges, or case status.
Fars reported that Melika Azizi, one of the detainees of the December 1404 protests in Masal county, has been sentenced to 6 months of imprisonment. Fars denied the news of a death sentence for her.
A video shows a student tearing images of Ruhollah Khomeini from their textbooks and calling him the cause of "impoverishing" the Iranian people.

Sri Lankan officials announced they moved 40 Iranian sailors from 19 ships ashore due to urgent need for medical care. According to the officials, the sailors returned to Iran after receiving medical services. Meanwhile, dozens of Iranian oil tankers have been stranded in Asian waters following the US naval blockade.

Ebrahim Rezaei, a member of the National Security Commission of the Parliament, reacted to the meeting of senior officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan in Tehran, saying Saudi Arabia has caused significant damage to Iran and Iran is a creditor to them. He accused Saudi Arabia of trying to overthrow the Islamic Republic and said the country must reconsider its past policies and adjust its relations with the Islamic Republic. Rezaei also said the Islamic Republic has taken steps to establish a new security system in the region and the resistance axis is forming a model called mosaic security.

Esmaeil Baqaei, spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic, reacted to Benjamin Netanyahu's threats by saying these threats are futile and a sign of desperation. He added that these threats only damage the credibility of the threateners among the public opinion in the region and Iran.

Jude Bellingham, the English midfielder of Real Madrid, played a key role in his team's 2-1 victory over Barcelona with a spectacular move in the 87th minute of El Clasico. This technical move drew widespread admiration from football fans and reactions on social media. Real Madrid defeated Barcelona 2-1 with goals from Kylian Mbappe and the cooperation of Bellingham and Camavinga.

A video received by Iran International shows that a group of Iranians residing in the UK held a ceremony for the birthday anniversary of Mohammad Reza Shah Pahlavi in the city of Sheffield on Sunday, 3 Aban.

The Court of Appeal confirmed the five-year prison sentence of Soheil Arabi, a blogger, on charges of "assembly and collusion to commit a crime against national security." He was also banned from social media activities for two years. The court cited a report from the Tehran Intelligence Organization of the IRGC, claiming Arabi had connections with "foreign financial networks" and encouraged people to "subversive actions."

Morteza Kazemian, a member of Iran International's editorial team, evaluated the visit of senior military and security officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan to Tehran as important in the current critical situation. He said these countries primarily seek to secure their national interests, and Saudi Arabia also tries to prevent escalation of tensions and the outbreak of war. According to Kazemian, this visit may involve conveying military and security warnings to the Islamic Republic.

Jalal Hashemi, chairman of the board of the retired employees association of Homa Airlines, stated that two retired employees of the company abandoned their treatment and died in the past two to three weeks due to inability to pay hospital costs. Hashemi said the average salary of Homa retirees is about 27 million tomans and health insurance services have been cut due to lack of financial resources.

On the eve of the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony to be held on Monday, October 26 in London, the competition for the most prestigious individual football award remains uncertain. Harry Kane, Lamin Yamal, and Kylian Mbappe are the main contenders, but each has weaknesses in their past season records. The Goal website wrote that unlike previous editions, no nominee has indisputable reasons to win the Ballon d'Or.

Street protests continue in several European cities focusing on rising living costs, housing crisis, and government economic policies. In France, Emmanuel Macron is going to Marseille to assess the restoration of public order, and protests have also been held in Prague, Lisbon, and Barcelona.

Videos received by Iran International show the memorial of Alireza Raeisi at his workplace, a poultry shop. A source close to Alireza Raeisi's family said that five knives belonging to his workplace were used as evidence against him in court.

Hossein Aghaei, a member of Iran International's editorial team, said the scope of possible US operations in the region depends on Washington's goals; from limited attacks on Iran's missile and nuclear capabilities to broader operations aimed at forcing the government to surrender or regime change. He also mentioned the possibility of attacks on military infrastructure and command centers and ground operations in the regime change scenario.

Fadahossein Maleki, a member of the National Security Commission of the Parliament, said Iran will achieve whatever it wants and is not far from using nuclear knowledge. He warned that in case of war, the Islamic Republic will target sites in Arab countries of the region and also mobile targets in the Persian Gulf and the Sea of Oman. These statements were made in an interview with Didban Iran.
